sampling.zeroCpuDisclosure: Production runtime CPU originates in Windows 100 ns Job Object counters and is normalized with floor rounding to catalog microseconds; compile-side Bun counters are already microseconds. Zero-valued samples remain valid.

resultContract.artifact: Artifact digest and sizeBytes are correctness-build facts, not repeated samples. New runner-bound results may also carry validated PE layout metadata (FileAlignment, SectionAlignment, SizeOfHeaders and section name/VirtualSize/rawSize); historical records without it are not measured.
resultContract.storage: Full-fidelity local results stay under ignored benchmarks/results and are consumed after a successful update; raw samples are never copied into Git.

bestMetricsContract.storage: Only the current lower-is-better value for each comparable category and metric is stored in this catalog.
bestMetricsContract.rule: Update compares only lower-is-better positive values inside one exact workload, source-equivalence, platform, artifact target, ABI, profile, host, recipe class and policy category; toolchain and recipe may improve that same cell, while correctness outputs never rank. Artifact layout metadata is emitted only on the artifact-size cell; an equal-size validated candidate with the same equivalence, source and recipe evidence may replace a metadata-less winner as a complete provenance update, while different cells or evidence are never merged.
